summary: Learn to calculate NPS, check response quality, analyse feedback and plan follow-up. Explore the five-day training outline.
lede: Net Promoter Score (NPS) training helps customer experience and service professionals turn recommendation feedback into service decisions. You’ll practise setting survey goals, checking samples and response quality, calculating and comparing scores, and analysing customer comments. The course also covers planning follow-up for detractor feedback and using ISO 10004 as a reference for customer satisfaction measurement.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who collect, interpret, or act on recommendation feedback and need a repeatable way to connect NPS results with customer service decisions.
modules: NPS Data Quality and Response Bias
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with customer feedback or customer service processes is useful. No coding is required; exercises use Excel and a supplied sample response file.
